## Problem and resulting behavior
A taught transformer procedure could accept an unrelated battery-cell request because shared measurement units were added to applicability. The existing compiler repair requires taught topic terms, declared input cues or explicit exclusions and preserves quantity parsing, citations, thresholds and refusal labels.

Acceptance can now be replayed without trusting an unsigned PASS summary. The new optional verifier requires independently selected tenant/task/expert, key, capability and runtime byte pins; checks the existing Ed25519 suite format with OpenSSL; and recomputes every frozen outcome using the trusted native CLI. It rejects altered cases, trust, signatures, capability bytes and incomplete results. It neither approves nor activates a capability.

This draft preserves the existing teaching scoreboard, explicit source-linked exclusion forms, lifecycle and prior dependency/audit fixes. It remains **NOT READY for the full W3 demonstration or release**.

## Validation and retained evidence
- Unchanged holdout **12/12**, adversarial suite **26/26**, including the **6/6 nonactivation subset**. Copied-plural negative controls remain rejected at 11/12 and 18/26.
- Fresh local continuation: **375 Python tests**, including **22 new replay tests** and the existing 29 applicability tests; **187 runtime tests**; formatting and Clippy pass. Counts overlap, and no security assertions or labels were weakened.
- Published implementation teaching CI [43174778630](https://github.com/richardrich999888-rgb/AIP-agent-identity-protocol-/actions/runs/43174778630) passes **197 focused Python tests** and **265 runtime/storage tests**. The latter excludes the separate full-workspace sandbox integration job.
- Fresh local, original applicability CI and new published-source CI packets pass separate OpenSSL signature checks and native replay of all 38 frozen cases. Outcomes use the existing trusted native engine, not a second implementation of domain semantics.
- Complete original CI ZIPs, extracted signed suites, rejected controls, source/binary hashes, hardware, exact commands, logs and scanner findings are retained under `docs/assurance/evidence/p0-050-replay/` and the preserved `p0-050-iteration-1/` checkpoint.
- The implementation and its CI merge have the same tree `82c751bee4e888c2854f429f01f71402ab611186`. Published files match reviewed local trees and retained source hashes.

Compiler repair: `ef3d9d434e5ed55e5994331abc91c03833f997ff` (already present when the replay continuation began).
Replay implementation: `91df9e96743804057ec3f51e7c629ef16a532a89`.
Final evidence checkpoint: `62db903bd66d7d86369e9fece44c826e7ef41093`.
The concurrent `975b245` checkpoint was fast-forwarded and preserved. No force push or main merge.

Existing serialized capabilities require recompile, revalidation, new authorized approval and explicit supersession. Synthetic suite keys do not prove expert identity or separate administrative control. Diagnostic reports remain unsigned; rerun the checks. No model, fresh sensor observation, complete commercial rehearsal or clean-machine offline install is established.

## CI and remaining acceptance
Implementation Security [43174778666](https://github.com/richardrich999888-rgb/AIP-agent-identity-protocol-/actions/runs/43174778666) fails exactly four HIGH retained-Helm-render findings, KSV-0009/0010/0118/0121. Original ZIP/SARIF are retained; nothing was suppressed or deleted. Secret scan passes. Full implementation CI [43174778542](https://github.com/richardrich999888-rgb/AIP-agent-identity-protocol-/actions/runs/43174778542) remains pending at this update; earlier applicability/checkpoint CI failed the three documented sandbox tests.

Final evidence head `62db903` was checked separately: [teaching CI](https://github.com/richardrich999888-rgb/AIP-agent-identity-protocol-/actions/runs/43175595174) and [harness contracts](https://github.com/richardrich999888-rgb/AIP-agent-identity-protocol-/actions/runs/43175595130) pass. [Full CI](https://github.com/richardrich999888-rgb/AIP-agent-identity-protocol-/actions/runs/43175595162) is still running. [Security](https://github.com/richardrich999888-rgb/AIP-agent-identity-protocol-/actions/runs/43175595193) is still running; its Trivy job has already failed. Pending checks are not passes.

Next bounded item: **resolve the teaching branch sandbox/CI discrepancy**, reviewing existing PR #16 and preserving authorized execution, loopback isolation, exit-code tamper rejection and unavailable-namespace refusal. Then address the retained scanner findings and general C1 linkage before composing signed expert approval.

Signed approval completion, packs, authenticated interfaces, staged models/runtime, live sensor qualification, unavailable original OVERLAY W4/W5 demos, full offline profiles, independent-host acceptance and ten-/twenty-run rehearsals remain open. See `docs/strategy/P0-050-STRATEGIC-GAP-MATRIX.md` and `docs/assurance/P0-050-OPEN-GAPS.md`. Keep this PR draft; external review and all required release gates remain pending.
